title: Cops Rescue 3-Month-Old Daughter From the Most Abusive Parents Ever
description:
On September 15th, 2025. Police arrested the parents of a 3-month-old following a concerning incident. When first responders arrived, the father handed the 3-month-old to rescue personnel and then immediately closed the door.  Paramedics also believed the 3-month-old may have been exposed to some substances. Paramedics checked the 3-month-old and quickly transported them to the hospital for further care. Doctors later told police the 3-month-old had concerning medical findings involving the head. Medical staff also said the findings appeared to have happened at different times, which raised concerns that the situation may have occurred more than once. During the investigation, the mother told police that the father had handled the 3-month-old roughly the night before. She said she saw him hold the 3-month-old by the legs and handle them roughly several times. She also told detectives that while trying to feed the 3-month-old, he became frustrated and handled them roughly again. The both were later arrested on a warrant. This is the bodycam footage of the events.
